description: This source file defines an Env class that provides static getter methods to access environment configuration variables, using the flutter_dotenv package.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class that provides access to environment variables with default values and derived properties.

methods.name: _getAppName
methods.description: Retrieves the application name from environment variables, defaults to 'Sigma Power'.

methods.name: _forceOnboarding
methods.description: Determines if onboarding is forced based on environment variable.

methods.name: _accent
methods.description: Gets the accent color hex code from environment variables, defaults to '#00D1FF'.

methods.name: _neonSecondary
methods.description: Gets the secondary neon color hex code, defaults to '#8A2BE2'.

methods.name: _debugLogging
methods.description: Checks if debug logging is enabled based on environment variable.
